## 🧰 Technical Resources

- 🔒 <a href="https://github.com/IsaakBM/cesmle-ocn-fetch" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ocean downscaling pipeline</a>  
  Private GitHub repository authored by Isaac Brito-Morales containing the project's main pipeline for producing downscaled oceanographic products. The workflow supports preparation, vertical matching, downscaling, organization, and export of ocean model outputs across multiple data sources, including GLORYS, Global Ocean Biogeochemistry Hindcast, IPCC/ESGF products, and CESM-based workflows. Access is currently restricted while the pipeline is under active development as a technical product of the project.

- 🔒 <a href="https://github.com/IsaakBM/pre_sdm_bio_data_prep" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Pre-SDM biological data preparation pipeline</a>  
  Private GitHub repository authored by Isaac Brito-Morales for preserving, harmonizing, quality-controlling, and exporting biological telemetry and observation records before species distribution modeling. Access is currently restricted because the repository includes project working data and sensitive biological information.

- 🌐 <a href="https://isaakbm-ocean-downscaling-viewer.share.connect.posit.cloud/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ocean downscaling viewer</a>  
  Interactive Shiny app for exploring selected downscaled oceanographic products generated through the project's downscaling pipeline.

- 🌐 <a href="https://isaakbm-megafauna-data-viewer.share.connect.posit.cloud/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Megafauna data viewer</a>  
  Interactive Shiny app for reviewing compiled megafauna telemetry and observation data used to support species distribution modeling, including spatial coverage and data availability.
